description: This source file is the code-behind for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It manages page load events, populates course dropdowns based on user session data, handles navigation buttons, initiates exams by querying the database for available questions, and checks if a student has already taken a specific exam. It also includes event handlers for grid selections to start exams for specific courses if the student hasn't taken them yet.
